d.ko: Grab your axe, hop on the handcar, and lose yourself in the forest. Chop trees, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the ride - alone or with a friend
d.en: Grab your axe, hop on the handcar, and lose yourself in the forest. Chop trees, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the ride - alone or with a friend
d.zh: 带上你的斧头，坐上手摇车，让自己沉浸在森林之中。砍树、升级装备，享受这段旅程 —— 无论是独自一人还是与友同行。
